title: DNA and RNA building blocks found in meteorites

tellings.quote: Speaking of DNA, it was just a few years back when a group of scientists from Japan and NASA actually confirmed something extraordinary.

plain: A few years ago, scientists from Japan and NASA confirmed that meteorites that fell in Canada, the United States and Australia contain the building blocks of DNA and RNA, Michels says. He calls it "something extraordinary" and tells it himself, without naming the study, because it would mean the ingredients of life can arrive from space.
